HPO-FIBP1-02.title: FIBDB052_P1_INDEX_GENERATION
HPO-FIBP1-02.what_is_authorized: The future implementation generates the P1 migration through the NORMAL drizzle-kit generate path, preserves the generated snapshot and journal exactly as generated, and then applies one bounded, byte-semantically constrained transformation to the generated SQL: adding IF NOT EXISTS to exactly the eight governed CREATE INDEX statements.
required_sequence: 1. Declare all 8 governed indexes in db/schema.ts.
2. Run the normal drizzle-kit generate path.
3. Preserve the generated snapshot and journal.
4. Before any apply, add IF NOT EXISTS manually ONLY to the eight governed CREATE INDEX statements.
5. Preserve index name, columns, order and predicate byte-semantically.
6. Audit, hash and test the final SQL.
HPO-FIBP1-02.why_no_FIB_baseline_amendment_is_require: The sealed FIB baseline requires CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS. This method produces exactly that in the final, applied SQL. The requirement is satisfied by the artifact that is applied, not by the intermediate generator output, so no amendment to the sealed baseline is required and none is requested.
HPO-FIBP1-02.why_generate_rather_than_custom: --custom produces an empty migration and leaves the author to hand-write both the SQL and the metadata. That path forfeits drizzle's own agreement check between db/schema.ts, the emitted SQL and the snapshot — the single strongest structural control this node has. The guard patch is deliberately applied AFTER generation precisely so that agreement is machine-established first and only then narrowed.

EIGHT_CREATE_TARGETS.rule: This is the complete and closed roster of index names the P1 implementing mission is authorized to CREATE. A name absent from this roster is not authorized. Each entry's governed name, relation, key list, key ORDER and predicate are frozen exactly. The governed NAME preserves FIBDB-052's own run_id spelling while the DEFINITION targets the live column calculation_run_id (S4_RUN_ID_NAMING); this asymmetry is deliberate and must not be 'corrected' by an implementer.

targets.governed_definition: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_evidence_versions_evidence_id_approved ON evidence_versions (evidence_id) WHERE review_status = 'approved'
targets.why_not_discharged_by_an_existing_object: A partial-predicate index cannot be discharged by an unconditional UNIQUE constraint (M-7). It is distinct from I-2 on the same relation.

targets.governed_definition: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_financial_proxy_versions_financial_proxy_id_approved ON financial_proxy_versions (financial_proxy_id) WHERE review_status = 'approved'
targets.key_list_provenance: The frozen FIBDB-052 text supplies NO key list for this clause. The key list (financial_proxy_id) is supplied by defect resolution S3_FINANCIAL_PROXY_PARTIAL_INDEX, derivation class TEXTUAL_SYMMETRY_WITHIN_ONE_FROZEN_SENTENCE, residual risk F-A5. An implementer may NOT change it; only a governed amendment may.
targets.why_not_discharged_by_an_existing_object: Partial; distinct from I-4 on the same relation, which is an unconditional UNIQUE and cannot discharge a partial (M-7).

targets.governed_definition: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_outcome_monetization_dispositions_run_id_outcome_id ON outcome_monetization_dispositions (calculation_run_id, outcome_id)
targets.why_not_discharged_by_an_existing_object: The existing uq_outcome_monetization_dispositions_outcome_run carries the columns in the REVERSE order (outcome_id, calculation_run_id) and does not serve a run-leading lookup. The existing idx_outcome_monetization_dispositions_run_id is a single-column PREFIX of this index and becomes redundant once this exists; DROPPING IT IS NOT AUTHORIZED (F-A1).

targets.governed_definition: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_evidence_sufficiency_determinations_run_id_outcome_id ON evidence_sufficiency_determinations (calculation_run_id, outcome_id)
targets.why_not_discharged_by_an_existing_object: The existing idx_evidence_sufficiency_determinations_outcome_run is (outcome_id, calculation_run_id), the reverse order. No run-leading index exists on this relation.

targets.governed_definition: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_counterfactual_assessments_run_id_outcome_id ON counterfactual_assessments (calculation_run_id, outcome_id)
targets.why_not_discharged_by_an_existing_object: The existing uq_counterfactual_assessments_outcome_run is the reverse order; idx_counterfactual_assessments_run_id is a single-column prefix. DROPPING THE PREFIX IS NOT AUTHORIZED (F-A1).

targets.governed_definition: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sensitivity_candidates_run_id_disposition ON sensitivity_candidates (calculation_run_id, disposition)
targets.why_not_discharged_by_an_existing_object: Neither uq_sensitivity_candidates_run_key (calculation_run_id, candidate_key) nor idx_sensitivity_candidates_run_id covers the disposition column.

targets.governed_definition: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_methodological_assumptions_project_id_materiality_flag ON methodological_assumptions (project_id, materiality_flag)
targets.why_not_discharged_by_an_existing_object: The existing idx_methodological_assumptions_project_id is a single-column prefix. DROPPING THE PREFIX IS NOT AUTHORIZED (F-A1).
targets.note: This is the longest identifier in the entire 12-name CREATE roster and therefore the one that pins the length-safety ceiling.

targets.governed_definition: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sroi_run_reviews_calculation_run_id_approved ON sroi_run_reviews (calculation_run_id) WHERE status = 'approved'
targets.predicate_column_note: The predicate column here is `status`, NOT `review_status`. I-3 and I-5 use review_status; I-13 uses status. This is a real per-relation difference and copying one predicate onto another relation is a defect.
targets.why_not_discharged_by_an_existing_object: The existing idx_sroi_run_reviews_calculation_run_id is NON-partial and is not a substitute for the partial form. This is the index the FIB baseline names as making Portfolio's approved-population selection (V-28) cheap; FIBIU-27 consumes it with NO_DB_OBJECT of its own (FIB:243, FIB:806).

WHY_IF_NOT_EXISTS_IS_NOT_PROTECTION_HERE.rule: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS resolves on the index NAME, not on the index DEFINITION (B20).
WHY_IF_NOT_EXISTS_IS_NOT_PROTECTION_HERE.consequence: For all four items a definitionally equivalent index already exists under a name the rule-derived naming scheme would NOT produce. IF NOT EXISTS therefore provides ZERO protection: emitting the rule-derived name would silently create a permanent duplicate rather than being inert. This is the single most important reason these four are verify-only rather than 'create with a guard'.
WHY_IF_NOT_EXISTS_IS_NOT_PROTECTION_HERE.epistemic_status: B20's name-based matching remains DERIVED, not machine-proven by any docs-only mission. The conservative disposition — verify, do not emit — is chosen in all four cases precisely so that if the semantics were somehow otherwise, the result is a no-op rather than a wrong index.

ABSENCE_OF_DETERMINATION.effect: FAIL CLOSED. The FIBDB-052 P1 PHASE is NOT fully DISCHARGED. Absence of a decision is not a discharge.

two_distinct_terminal_states.rule: This authority requires that two states be kept lexically distinct in every report, artifact and commit message. Collapsing them is the specific false claim this section exists to prevent.

P1_DDL_SUBPACKAGE_COMPLETE.definition: The 8 CREATE targets exist under exactly their governed names with exactly their governed definitions; the 4 verify-only objects are verified present and unchanged with zero duplicate DDL; zero DDL was emitted for I-10; and every gate in EXIT_GATES passed.

FIBDB052_P1_PHASE_DISCHARGED.definition: P1_DDL_SUBPACKAGE_COMPLETE **and** the I-10 access-path determination has been MADE, RECORDED with its measured call site, and ACTIONED (discharged under RUN_SCOPED_ONLY, or a governed GIN authority obtained and executed under CANDIDATE_SCOPED).

two_distinct_terminal_states.permitted_claim_for_the_migration_missio: The migration mission MAY claim P1_DDL_SUBPACKAGE_COMPLETE once its gates pass. It MAY NOT claim FIBDB052_P1_PHASE_DISCHARGED, and it MAY NOT claim FIBDB-052 COMPLETE in any form (that additionally spans P2/P4/P5 and is G2-gated).
two_distinct_terminal_states.why_this_distinction_is_load_bearing: Without it, a mission that correctly emits 8 indexes and correctly emits nothing for I-10 has no vocabulary for what it achieved, and the nearest available word — 'complete' — is false. Naming the weaker state makes honest reporting the path of least resistance rather than an act of restraint.

explicitly_prohibited_under_this_authori: Inventing a candidate_id column on sensitivity_scenarios, or any column, to satisfy the frozen text.
Emitting a GIN index on candidate_ids, or any GIN index at all, under the P1 migration.

Re-expressing I-10 to calculation_run_id in order to make it a no-op against an index that already exists. This would read as a resolution but is a silent narrowing that asserts a fact about unwritten code.
Dropping the obligation on the ground that the named column does not exist.
Treating the migration mission's silence on I-10 as the determination.

GENERATE_GUARD_PATCH_CONTRACT.rule: HPO-FIBP1-02 frozen as a machine-verifiable implementation contract. The sequence is ORDERED and each step's output is evidence for the next. A step may not be skipped, reordered or merged.

SEQUENCE.action: Edit db/schema.ts with EXACTLY 8 index declarations.
SEQUENCE.verification: The diff of db/schema.ts adds exactly 8 index declarations and changes nothing else. Names, relations, key lists, key ORDER and predicates match EIGHT_CREATE_TARGETS byte-for-byte in semantics.

SEQUENCE.action: Run the NORMAL drizzle-kit generate path.
SEQUENCE.verification: The command actually run is recorded verbatim. It does NOT carry --custom.

The generated migration file, the generated meta/<ORD>_snapshot.json and the appended meta/_journal.json entry are captured BEFORE any manual edit, so that step F has an unmodified reference to diff against.

SEQUENCE.action: Verify EXACTLY the expected 8 CREATE INDEX statements were generated.
SEQUENCE.verification: Statement count in the generated SQL is exactly 8. Each is a CREATE INDEX. Each matches one of the 8 governed targets on name, relation, key list, key order and predicate. Zero unmatched statements; zero unmatched targets.
SEQUENCE.fails_closed_on: A ninth statement, a missing statement, a DROP, an ALTER, or a CREATE of any object other than an index.

SEQUENCE.action: Bounded transformation: CREATE INDEX -> CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS, for those 8 statements ONLY.
SEQUENCE.verification: Exactly 8 occurrences of the token sequence IF NOT EXISTS are added. Zero other tokens are added, removed or reordered.
SEQUENCE.prohibited: Applying the transformation to any statement outside the 8; applying it to a file other than the generated migration; applying it to the snapshot or the journal.

SEQUENCE.action: Prove NO other byte-semantic SQL change.
SEQUENCE.verification: A diff between the step-C capture and the final SQL shows exactly 8 insertions of ' IF NOT EXISTS' and nothing else. Whitespace, statement order, quoting and identifier casing are unchanged.
SEQUENCE.why_this_step_exists: Step E is a manual edit to a generated artifact. Without F, the guarantee that generation established in D is unverifiable after E. F is what makes the manual edit auditable rather than trusted.

SEQUENCE.action: Recompute and record every generated hash and manifest evidence the repository requires.
SEQUENCE.verification: The db/hosted/baseline-manifest.ts entry's sha256 is computed over the FINAL, guard-patched, LF-normalized bytes — not over the step-C capture. The prepared-journal wrapper wraps the FINAL bytes.
SEQUENCE.windows_hazard: The stored git blob for db/migrations/** is LF (pinned by .gitattributes). Any hash computed over CRLF working-tree bytes will not match. Hash the LF form.

SEQUENCE.action: Run structural AND real-PostgreSQL verification BEFORE any apply.
SEQUENCE.verification: Both the structural suite and the disposable-PostgreSQL suite run with COLLECTED > 0 and pass. A skipped real-PG suite is NOT green.
SEQUENCE.boundary: The only apply permitted at this step is against a disposable PostgreSQL container that is destroyed afterwards. See DEPLOYMENT_BOUNDARY.

PROHIBITED_ABSOLUTELY.rule: Each item below is prohibited regardless of intent, framing or apparent harmlessness. A mission that believes it has found a case where one is warranted has exceeded this authority and must STOP and escalate.
items: Manual synthesis of, or manual edit to, db/migrations/meta/_journal.json beyond the single entry drizzle-kit itself appended.
Any additional DDL — a ninth index, a table, a column, a constraint, a policy, a trigger, a function, an extension, a role statement or an ownership statement.
DROP of anything, including the redundant single-column prefix indexes that I-6, I-8 and I-12 subsume. F-A1 records the redundancy; it does NOT authorize the cleanup.
CONCURRENTLY on any statement. It cannot run inside a transaction, and a drizzle migration file is applied as a whole-file transaction.
Renaming any index, constraint, table or column.
Altering any predicate, including normalizing quoting or operator spelling.
Altering column order in any index key list.

GENERATE_GUARD_PATCH_CONTRACT.WHY_WHOLE_FILE_ROLLBACK_MATTERS_HERE: A migration transaction rolls back as a WHOLE FILE. One bad statement discards every other statement in that file, including correct ones. This is why step D's exact-count verification runs BEFORE the guard patch and before any apply: an unnoticed ninth statement does not partially succeed, it silently voids all eight.

GRANT_MUST_BE_NARROWER_THAN_THE_PROTECTE.rule: The DEFAULT protected pattern is the broad db/prepared/**. The P1 GRANT must be the narrow db/prepared/journal/**. NO BLANKET db/prepared/** GRANT MAY BE REQUESTED OR ISSUED.

The breadth of the PROTECTION is not a licence for breadth in the GRANT; the grant authorizes an exact union of patterns, and a sibling under db/prepared/ that matches the default pattern but not the grant's narrower pattern is correctly refused.

CHECKPOINT_B0_EXPLICITLY_EXCLUDED.rule: checkpoint-b0 is NOT included in the expected P1 protected surface and MUST NOT be added on the strength of precedent, convenience, or a prior mission's grant shape.

CHECKPOINT_B0_EXPLICITLY_EXCLUDED.why_stated_negatively: Several prior grants in this repository carry a checkpoint-b0 probe pattern. Copying a grant shape is the most likely way a P1 mission would silently widen its own protected surface, and it would look like precedent-following rather than expansion.

PROTECTED_SURFACE.re_measurement_obligation: The allocating mission MUST derive its own --allow list from its own measured diff at its own AS_OF_HEAD. It may NOT copy this list. If its measured diff contains a protected path not listed here, that is a SCOPE DELTA requiring adjudication — never a silent addition on the ground that 'it changed anyway'.

DEPLOYMENT_BOUNDARY.rule: FROZEN. There is no condition under which this authority authorizes an apply anywhere other than a disposable, destroyed-afterwards PostgreSQL container. A future mission that believes it has found one has misread this section.
DEPLOYMENT_BOUNDARY.what_IS_permitted: Disposable rehearsal only — applying the unit against a fresh, throwaway PostgreSQL container via pnpm db:audit:disposable, and destroying it afterwards.
DEPLOYMENT_BOUNDARY.sufficiency: Disposable PostgreSQL is SUFFICIENT for P1 implementation verification. A lock or load rehearsal is NOT required unless FUTURE EVIDENCE proves it is; no such evidence exists at AS_OF_HEAD.
DEPLOYMENT_BOUNDARY.why_a_lock_rehearsal_is_not_currently_re: P1 emits 8 plain (non-CONCURRENT) CREATE INDEX statements against relations that are, at AS_OF_HEAD, part of an unshipped FIBIU-19 surface. The ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock a plain CREATE INDEX takes is only a production concern against a live, loaded table. This is recorded as the REASON the rehearsal is not required, so that a future mission can see exactly which premise would have to change for it to become required.

COMMERCIAL_V1_PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZATION.rule: Nothing in this authority constitutes, implies or advances Commercial V1 production authorization. P1 is a performance support package on the Drizzle track. Shipping it is not evidence of production readiness for anything.

COMPANION_MANIFEST.relationship: The manifest is the MACHINE-READABLE form of this authority's proof obligations. Where the two could be read as disagreeing, the manifest's controls are the executable contract and this authority is the reason they exist. Neither may be satisfied without the other.
COMPANION_MANIFEST.why_the_obligation_lives_here_and_not_in: v1.0.1's MANIFEST_DISPOSITION assigns the index-existence verification obligation to 'the manifest of the FUTURE mission that emits the DDL, frozen before that implementation begins'. This IS that manifest. WAVE3_TEST_MANIFEST_v1.0.0.json remains the Wave 3 BEHAVIOURAL contract for the composition function, SoD and findings, and is NOT amended, edited or superseded by this mission.
